label: first occurrence of 1/y/2/d/c/0 during input phase (context-gated)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original-input phase (99.7% of mass), on steps whose input is one of a small token set {1, y, 2, d, c, 0} (about 95% of mass), mostly on that token's first occurrence, and mostly early (t <= 4). It practically never fires at the delimiter or during the copy phase. Input 1 at t=0 always fires, but weakly (3.5% of mass). The largest activations come at t=1..4 in sequences that start with l or e, or right after y/r/s/j. Precision is low (about 9%): these tokens are inactive in most contexts, and the history-dependent gating was not captured by simple predicates (best context-gated version reached F1 about 0.34).
